parts.title: The Garden
parts.text: Lucia, Remy, and Hiro helped their teacher plant a butterfly garden at school. Each morning, tiny drops of **dew** sparkled on the leaves. One day, Remy found a green **caterpillar** munching on a leaf. “What will it become?” he asked.

parts.title: A Big Change
parts.text: The caterpillar ate and ate. Then it hung from a twig and made a green **chrysalis**. Their teacher said a moth would spin a silky **cocoon** instead. Every day the children checked on it.

parts.title: Wings in the Sun
parts.text: One sunny morning, the shell cracked open. A **monarch** butterfly crawled out with wet, folded wings. Slowly, it began to **unfurl** them in the sun, and bright orange wings opened wide. It twitched one thin **antenna**, then the other. Soon it began to **flit** from flower to flower. It was **graceful**, like a tiny dancer. It landed on a **bud** that was about to open and used its long tongue to **sip** sweet **nectar**.

parts.title: Letting Go
parts.text: The children watched the butterfly rise over the fence and fly away. Lucia felt a little sad, but Remy smiled. “It is free now,” he said. They had waited and watched, and they had seen something amazing.
